title: ADR-0002 — Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) Rules
description: Machine-readable rules encoding ADR-0002 Clean Hexagonal Architecture. Mandatory structural pattern for all Evolith applications.

rules.title: Core (Domain) has zero framework dependencies
rules.description: The Core/Domain layer MUST contain only pure TypeScript classes. Zero imports from NestJS, TypeORM, Express, or any external SDK. Contains entities, value objects, and port interfaces only.
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §Decision: Core is pure TypeScript. Framework coupling prevents domain extraction and pure testing.
rules.validationQuery: Static analysis: Core layer files import no framework packages (nestjs, typeorm, express, mongoose).

rules.title: Application layer imports Core only
rules.description: Application layer (Use Cases) may import Core classes and NestJS DI decorators only. No infrastructure imports (database adapters, external SDKs).
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §Decision: Application orchestrates Core logic. Infrastructure belongs in adapters.
rules.validationQuery: Application layer files import only Core layer and @nestjs/common decorators.

rules.title: Infrastructure (Adapters) implements Core ports
rules.description: Infrastructure layer contains concrete implementations of Core port interfaces (TypeOrmUserRepository, BcryptPasswordHasher). All framework and SDK imports live exclusively here.
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §Decision: Infrastructure is the adapter layer. It implements the ports defined by Core.
rules.validationQuery: Infrastructure files implement interfaces defined in Core layer. No domain logic lives here.

rules.title: Dependency direction: Infrastructure → Application → Core
rules.description: Dependency direction is strictly enforced: Infrastructure depends on Application, Application depends on Core. Never the reverse.
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §Decision: Dependency inversion is the core principle of hexagonal architecture.
rules.validationQuery: eslint-plugin-boundaries or equivalent static analysis enforces no backward imports.

rules.title: AOP concerns prohibited in Core/Application layers
rules.description: Cross-cutting concerns (Logging, Auditing, OTel, Caching, Transactions) MUST NOT hard-couple third-party decorators or SDKs inside Core or Application layers. Prohibited: @SentryCapture, @OpentelemetrySpan, @Cacheable on UseCase methods.
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §4: AOP isolation rule. Framework decorators in domain pollute the domain with infrastructure concerns.
rules.validationQuery: Core/Application classes have no imports from Sentry, OpenTelemetry SDK, caching libraries, or transaction managers.

rules.title: AOP implemented exclusively in Infrastructure layer
rules.description: Cross-cutting concerns MUST be encapsulated exclusively inside NestJS Interceptors, Middleware, or Decorator Wrappers residing in the Infrastructure/Adapter layer, wrapping pure UseCase execution from the outside.
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §4: AOP in adapters preserves domain purity while enabling observability.
rules.validationQuery: AOP implementations (interceptors, middleware, decorators) exist only in Infrastructure layer.

rules.title: Core domain tests run without framework bootstrap
rules.description: Pure domain tests (entities, value objects, port interfaces) MUST run in milliseconds with no database or framework setup. Tests must not execute IO or container startups.
rules.rationale: ADR-0002 §Consequences: Pure domain tests are fast and framework-independent.
rules.validationQuery: Domain unit tests execute without TestBed or testcontainer initialization. Average execution time < 50ms per test file.

exitCriteria.description: All HXA rules are validated in CI via eslint-plugin-boundaries and import analysis.
